skill.displayName: AI Animation Generator – Animate Images & Create AI Videos Online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: AI image animation — animate a static image into a dynamic video using Kling

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ai-image-animation-openapi-skill.
- Enables animating static images into dynamic videos using Kling via WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports secure API key usage with strict instructions and HTTPS-only communication.
- Provides endpoints to start animation runs, check status, and upload images.
- Allows customization of animation description, model version, duration, audio generation, and batch count.
